text:
mia: Hey team — noticed a SCIM bulk provision failure for tenant `acme-corp` right after we pushed the RBAC role rename. KMS decrypt errors showing up in the auth-proxy logs. Anyone else seeing this?
security-bot: :rotating_light: alert: service-account-scim-provisioner returned 403 -> KMS_DECRYPT_CONTEXT_MISMATCH for 12 events (see /var/log/provisioner/2023-11-xx.log).
raj: I saw the alert. Quick question: did the role rename touch the service account extID or the encryption context keys?
mia: We renamed the role from `acct-admin` -> `customer-admin`. No direct changes to extIDs, but the deploy included the new RBAC mapping that references `role.metadata.team`.
olga: If mapping references changed, the provisioner might be using a cached KMS context that includes the old role name. KMS context mismatch often from a subtle change in the JSON used for EncryptContext.
devops: Pasting the error block I pulled:```2023-11-12T08:14:02Z auth-proxy[pid=1123] ERROR KMS Decrypt failed: com.amazon.kms.exceptions.DecryptContextMismatchException: Decryption failed due to mismatch in encryption context fields: {tenant=acme-corp,extid=svc-scim-123,role=acct-admin}```
mia: Thanks. That log shows the encrypted blob still expects `role=acct-admin`. Our new mapping stores `role=customer-admin`. So older blobs won't decrypt until rewrapped.
raj: Do we know which component produced the original Encrypt with that context? It should be the provisioning backfill job from last year.
olga: Likely. Two mitigation options: 1) Backfill re-encrypt: run a rewrap using the new context (preferred). 2) Add temporary fallback in decrypt code to accept either role value (quick but messy).
devops: I tried a quick curl to simulate SCIM call and got 403:```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://scim.redwood.example.com/ServiceProviders/2.0/Bulk -d @batch.json```response: 403 Forbidden {"error":"KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR"}
mia: Can we inspect AWS KMS key aliases and check if a rotation or alias swap happened during deploy? Command: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/ci-scim` and `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/ci-scim` should help.
raj: I ran `aws kms list-keys` in the org account and nothing shows a rotation in the window. But the deploy pipeline did a config bump that updated the encryption context keys used by the provisioner. I have a PR that changed the context shape: https://git.internal/r/provisioner/PR/987
olga: That PR explains it — the reformatting changed the order/keys which breaks deterministic context equality. We need to rewrap historical secrets with the new canonical context.
mia: Proposed runbook: 1) Pause new SCIM bulk jobs (scale down provisioner to 0) 2) Re-encrypt affected blobs from S3 using a small script that loads with old context and re-put with new context 3) Resume. Anyone object?
devops: Agree. I can write the rewrap script. Quick pseudo:```for obj in $(aws s3 ls s3://scim-enc/acme/ --recursive); do aws s3 cp s3://scim-enc/acme/$obj - | decrypt --context role=acct-admin | encrypt --context role=customer-admin | aws s3 cp - s3://scim-enc/acme/$obj; done```Need a safe dry-run first.
raj: Two safeguards: 1) run against a small sample prefix, 2) snapshot current bucket (versioning enabled) before changes, 3) add a fallback flag so provisioner can accept old context for 1 hour during cutover.
olga: Also update audit log entries: ensure the rewrap job writes an audit event per object (who/when/orig-context/new-context). Compliance will want that.
mia: Good call. Also we should check service-account used for rewrap has kms:Decrypt permission for both contexts. @devops can you confirm IAM permissions?
devops: Will confirm. I suspect the deploy changed condition keys in the IAM policy; I'll check `aws iam get-role --role-name scim-rewraper` and post the diff.
security-bot: Note: If rewrap job touches >10K objects, please open a short incident for change control per policy SCIM-CHG-202.
mia: OK assigning to @raj for coordination, @devops for scripts/permissions, @olga for audit/QA. Target: run dry-run within 90 minutes, full rewrap in maintenance window tonight.
raj: I'll open an internal ticket and attach the PR diff + list of affected tenants. ETA 60m for dry-run prep.
olga: I'll draft the audit event schema: `{"object":"s3://...","old_context":{...},"new_context":{...},"performed_by":"scim-rewraper","timestamp":"..."}` and share in the ticket.
mia: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers post the exact error and the object key. I'll keep the channel updated. :thumbsup:
